message.content:
**Blues scale in A**

| Note | Interval from previous note | Interval class |
|------|-----------------------------|----------------|
| A    | —                           | —              |
| C    | +3 semitones (minor 3rd)    | 3              |
| D    | +2 semitones (perfect 4th)  | 2              |
| Eb   | +1 semitone (blue note)     | 1              |
| E    | +1 semitone (perfect 5th)   | 1              |
| G    | +3 semitones (minor 7th)    | 3              |

So the **pattern of intervals** (between successive notes) is:

```
3 – 2 – 1 – 1 – 3
```

If you prefer the **interval class notation** relative to the root:

```
1, b3, 4, b5, 5, b7
```

**In plain notes:**  
A – C – D – Eb – E – G

(And the last interval from G back up to the next A is +2 semitones, completing the octave.)
